title: The dashboard names why the base is degraded, and calls a model down only when one is
goal: The DEGRADED banner lists the reasons; its model-failure sentence and the map's standby state appear only when a model route or the brain is down
acceptance: Test committed failing first: a failed overnight Instrumentality run shows as its own reason, without the model-failure sentence and without marking the base standby
A route or brain reason keeps the sentence and the standby state; every reason is shown, escaped
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 from the owner's report on NERV-01's dashboard. Not a measurement.
